decision_rule.accept: specific_recall improves AND negative_rejection does not decrease AND specific_precision = 1.0
decision_rule.reject: specific_recall does not improve OR negative_rejection decreases OR false positives appear
decision_rule.stop: If no individual change produces >=10pp recall improvement, STOP evaluator engineering
decision_rule.no_post_hoc: Do not select the best-looking configuration post hoc

pre_registered_rule.dev_set: V3 oracle dev cases (5 SPECIFIC + 5 NOT_SPECIFIC) — same cases for all phases
pre_registered_rule.rationale: Using V3 dev cases because mining new dev set with word-boundary regexes is too slow (5 SPECIFIC found in 72K patents). The ablation compares PROMPT changes, not oracle changes, so using the same dev set is valid.
